entries.english:
Lilien (Line Waldau)—general papers—

1–2: 2 postcards from Mathilde von Lilien-Waldau, Freiin to Ernst Viktor and Falko von Lilien-Waldau, Freiherr, depicting Waldau Castle and the Old Castle Church at Waldau, 1960. 2: 4 black-and-white and 8 color photographs: The English House in Danzig, 1925–1975; corbels from the gable of the English House bearing the coats of arms of the Lilie and Rosenberg families. 3–13: collection file on Knippenburg Castle, Bottrop. 3–7: 3 copies and 2 black-and-white photographs: oil painting of Knippenburg; Knippenburg, 1952. 8–12: printed matter: n.a., City of Bottrop (Knippenburg), from The Architectural and Art Monuments of Westphalia, vol. 39, n.d., pp. 69, 70, 72 (copy). 13: printed matter: Bottrop City Archive, from Cultural Guide to the City of Bottrop, n.d., after 1975, pp. 51–54. 14–16: 2 black-and-white photographs, 1 copy: proof-of-nobility panel for Johann Caspar Theodor von Lilien-Waldau, Freiherr (1734–1784). 15–18: 2 color photographs, 2 copies: proof-of-nobility panel for the children of Johann Caspar Theodor von Lilien-Waldau, Freiherr and his wife Eleonore, née von Rummel, Freiin (1734–1796). 19–22: 5 color photographs, 1 negative: proof-of-nobility panel for Henriette von Lilien-Waldau, Freiin (1767–1803), daughter of Caspar Theodor and Eleonore von Lilien-Waldau, Freiherr. 23: copy of the family tree of Carl Joseph von Lilien-Waldau, Freiherr (1766–1840), for Stoppenberg Abbey (copy). 24–29: proof-of-nobility panel for Carl Joseph von Lilien-Waldau, Freiherr (5 copies). 30: family tree for Maria Theresia von Lilien-Waldau, Freifrau, née von Lamberg-Ammerang, Gräfin, wife of Franz Anton von Lilien-Waldau, Freiherr (1769–1839), 1815 (copy). 31–32: 1 black-and-white photograph, 1 copy: family tree for Johann (Hans) Maria von Lilien-Waldau, Freiherr (1809–1854), 1815. 33–36: 2 black-and-white photographs, 2 copies: princely Thurn and Taxis document of 24 July 1761 for Johann Caspar Theodor von Lilien-Waldau, Freiherr. 37–42: 3 black-and-white photographs, 3 copies: fief charters for the male and female fiefs of Waldau, 7 January 1813, 22 September 1837, 2 January 1841. 43–45: excerpt from the nobility register of the Kingdom of Bavaria, with the entry for Ernst Bruno von Lilien, Freiherr (1873–1926), 1898 (copy). 46–49: certificate of descent for Ernst Bruno von Lilien, Freiherr-Waldau, prepared by the Royal Bavarian Imperial Herald, 1917 (2 copies). 50: death notice for Marie Michaeline von Lilien-Waldau, Freiin (1841–1861) (copy). 51–52: letter from the Catholic parish office of Appersdorf to Rfr. von Lilien-Waldau, 1909; enclosed: birth and baptismal certificate for Amalia Eva Josepha Breyer. 53: letter from P. Poiger, parish priest in Chamerau, concerning an entry in the marriage register about the marriage of Maria Anna Walburga Johanna Charitas, daughter of Joseph Wenceslaus von Schönprunn, to Antonius, son of Freiherr Joseph Wilhelm von Reivach und Kürendorff, 1909. 54–56: correspondence of the Royal Bavarian Court Chaplaincy of Nymphenburg, Munich, with the Catholic parish office of Appersdorf and the Archbishop's Cathedral Parish Office of Freiburg concerning entries in the marriage register about the marriage of Josef Breyer to Josefa Freiin von Schönprunn, among others, and in the baptismal register concerning Josef Breyer (born circa 1780), among others, 1911. 57: letter from the Catholic parish office mentioning Maria Sophia Breyer, 1911. 58–60: letter to Anton Ernst von Lilien-Waldau, Freiherr from the University Scholarship Administration concerning the von Rummel scholarship, 1874. 61: certificate for Mathilde von Lilien-Waldau, Freiin, 1874. 62: notes concerning the descent of a von Lilien. 63–76: printed matter: n.a., City of Bottrop, from The Architectural and Art Monuments of Westphalia, vol. 39, n.d., pp. 67–72 (2 copies). 77–89: correspondence of Falko von Lilien-Waldau, Freiherr with the State Archives of North Rhine-Westphalia, Düsseldorf State Archives and Münster State Archives, concerning Lilien family research, 2004; therein: documents from 1322–1360 mentioning members of the Lilien family (one copy each). 90: death notice for Franz Anton von Lilien-Waldau, Freiherr, 1839 (1 copy). 91–93: death notice for Maria Theresia Augusta Ursula von Buchenberg, Freifrau, née von Lilien, Freiin, 1822 (3 copies). 94: watercolor of Steppenberg Castle on the Naab, Upper Palatinate (artist uncertain).
